Gold ETF holdings remain broadly stable, but 166 tonnes of inflows accumulated at higher prices could face selling pressure. Meanwhile, one-month implied volatility has surged above 25%. UBS expects buyers to remain cautious ahead of the Fed meeting but sees potential opportunities for long-term investors.
